dsh-kanban.acceptance.title: Review Acceptance Gate
dsh-kanban.archive.hint: Cards that spent their term in Done. Nothing is deleted: a restored card returns to the column it left.
dsh-kanban.batch.hint: One session for all of them. Tasks arrive one at a time: the agent takes the next when it finishes the current one. Only the first moves to In progress — the rest wait their turn where they are.
dsh-kanban.batch.title: Start {n} tasks in one chat
dsh-kanban.board.backHint: Close the board and return to the conversation
dsh-kanban.board.exportHint: Download the whole board as JSON
dsh-kanban.board.someFailed: Done for {done} of {total}; the rest refused.
dsh-kanban.board.waitCountHint: Tasks where the agent asked a question or wants permission.
dsh-kanban.card.packHint: Started together, one session; the agent takes them in this order.
dsh-kanban.checklist.title: Definition of Done (DoD)
dsh-kanban.chip.noteHint: The note is appended to the task body. The body goes to the agent with the first message, so a note left before the start reaches the work and one left after does not.
dsh-kanban.comments.title: Discussion & Comments
dsh-kanban.dialog.bodyHint: Goes to the agent as the first message when the task starts.
dsh-kanban.dialog.kindPlainHint: A note that touches no repository. It lives on the simple board and never reaches Gitea.
dsh-kanban.dialog.kindProjectHint: An issue is created in Gitea and the card is bound to it. The card lives on the project board.
dsh-kanban.dialog.repoNewHint: It will be created in the organisation: private and empty, no README and no scaffolding. Creating a repository cannot be undone from here.
dsh-kanban.dialog.title: New task
dsh-kanban.diff.title: Git Changes & Diff
dsh-kanban.epic.triageHelp: Enter one subtask title per line. Child tasks will be linked to this Epic.
dsh-kanban.error.bad-repo-name: A repository name may contain only Latin letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
dsh-kanban.error.badImport: That file is not a valid board backup.
dsh-kanban.error.gitea-unreachable: Gitea did not answer, so there is nobody to take the task as.
dsh-kanban.error.giteaAbsent: The Gitea plugin is not installed, so importing is unavailable.
dsh-kanban.error.giteaUnconfigured: Configure Gitea in the Gitea plugin card first.
dsh-kanban.error.issue-not-created: The issue was not created. If the repository was new, it stayed — nothing was deleted.
dsh-kanban.error.modelNotSelected: No model selected — pick one in Settings, or type it here.
dsh-kanban.error.no-live-sessions: No running session to queue into.
dsh-kanban.error.permission-refused: The access level was refused; the task was not started.
dsh-kanban.error.permission-unavailable: This deployment offers no access levels — the task was not started, so it could not run with wider rights than asked.
dsh-kanban.error.repo-not-created: The repository was not created; nothing else was done.
dsh-kanban.error.repo-required: Choose a repository or name a new one.
dsh-kanban.error.session-not-live: That session is no longer running.
dsh-kanban.error.sessionNotOpened: The session started ({id}) but this build cannot switch to it. Find it in the session list.
dsh-kanban.error.task-not-queued: This task is not in a queue.
dsh-kanban.error.taskHasNoIssue: This task has no Gitea issue behind it.
dsh-kanban.error.timeout: Request timed out. Please try again.
dsh-kanban.facet.author: Author
dsh-kanban.field.archiveAfterDays: Archive a done card after, days
dsh-kanban.field.staleAfterMin: Call a task silent after, minutes
dsh-kanban.field.watchRepos: Narrow the pull to these repositories
dsh-kanban.hint.announceToAgent: Injects guidance section into the agent system prompt.
dsh-kanban.hint.archiveAfterDays: Counted from the moment the card entered Done. Zero keeps everything on the board.
dsh-kanban.hint.autoSyncSessions: Automatically create board cards for standard DSH chat conversations.
dsh-kanban.hint.boardToolEnabled: Off until the workflow skill stops forbidding this CLI to touch a kanban.
dsh-kanban.hint.columnNames: Pairs «id=Name», comma separated, for example «backlog=Ideas, review=Check». Empty keeps the usual names.
dsh-kanban.hint.cronEnabled: Runs tasks on scheduled 5-field cron on the host even when browser is closed.
dsh-kanban.hint.defaultProjectRoot: Where project working copies live. Empty means the harness working directory.
dsh-kanban.hint.giteaOwner: Whose repositories the board watches. Empty is fine while the token belongs to exactly one organisation.
dsh-kanban.hint.giteaTokenRef: The NAME of a DSH credential holding the token. Never type the token itself here.
dsh-kanban.hint.giteaUrl: For example https://gitea.example.com. Empty means importing is unavailable.
dsh-kanban.hint.githubOwner: Default GitHub account to watch. Empty uses authenticated user.
dsh-kanban.hint.githubTokenRef: Name of DSH credential holding GitHub PAT or App token. Never type raw token.
dsh-kanban.hint.githubWebhookSecretRef: Name of DSH credential holding GitHub webhook secret (HMAC-SHA256).
dsh-kanban.hint.label: Empty means no label is set for this column.
dsh-kanban.hint.limit: Zero means no limit. Going over is highlighted, never blocked.
dsh-kanban.hint.permissionGateEnabled: Requires manual user confirmation before launching tasks with elevated permissions.
dsh-kanban.hint.preventIdleSleep: Keeps the host awake while tasks are running or armed.
dsh-kanban.hint.progressDumpEnabled: Captures session progress dumps and provides clean preambles to subsequent agents.
dsh-kanban.hint.pushToGitea: A card reaching Done closes its issue. The board sets no labels: the stage is already visible from the branch and the pull request.
dsh-kanban.hint.replyInstruction: Appended to every first message — the answer language, for instance. Empty adds nothing.
dsh-kanban.hint.sessionDefaultPermission: Tasks requesting permissions above this rank require confirmation.
dsh-kanban.hint.staleAfterMin: Only tasks that have a session are marked. Zero turns the mark off.
dsh-kanban.hint.startPrompt: Template for the first message to the agent. Empty means the built-in template.
dsh-kanban.hint.syncIntervalSec: Zero turns the check off. Below fifteen seconds is raised to fifteen.
dsh-kanban.hint.watchRepos: Comma separated, «owner/repo» or just «repo». Empty means every repository of the organisation that has open issues.
dsh-kanban.hint.webhookSecretRef: NAME of a DSH credential holding the Gitea webhook secret. Empty leaves only polling.
dsh-kanban.hint.worktreeIsolation: Creates a separate git worktree for each task session to prevent file collisions.
dsh-kanban.hint.worktreeRoot: Custom folder for task worktrees. Leave empty to use $DSH_HOME/worktrees.
dsh-kanban.metrics.empty: No transitions yet — nothing to measure.
dsh-kanban.metrics.hint: {n} tasks on the board · done in a week: {week} · in a month: {month}
dsh-kanban.metrics.noStale: Nothing has been sitting that long.
dsh-kanban.move.backlog: Work on the task stops: the agent’s running turn is aborted. With no session, the card just moves.
dsh-kanban.move.cleanup: The agent deletes the Gitea branch, the worktree and the local branch, and records that in the issue.
dsh-kanban.move.deploy: The agent merges the pull request and deploys. This move IS your explicit go-ahead for the deploy — the agent will not ask again.
dsh-kanban.move.done: The task counts as finished. This is a human decision: the agent never moves a card here itself.
dsh-kanban.move.in-progress: The agent is told to start or continue the implementation.
dsh-kanban.move.review: The agent takes the work to review: drops the draft mark from the pull request and asks for a check.
dsh-kanban.move.title: Move to “{column}”?
dsh-kanban.panel.author: by {who}
dsh-kanban.panel.continueHint: The task keeps its own chat: the existing session is opened, not a new one.
dsh-kanban.panel.messageHint: Edit before sending. Empty falls back to the built-in text.
dsh-kanban.panel.startHint: A dedicated agent session opens for this task. Branch and worktree are created by the agent after its preflight, not here.
dsh-kanban.panel.startWorkflowHint: Run multi-agent workflow via core workflow engine
dsh-kanban.panel.workDirHint: The project root is not set in settings, so this folder is used.
dsh-kanban.plan.title: Agent plan
dsh-kanban.queue.hint: The task joins the session queue: the agent takes it when it finishes the current work. Until then the card stays where it is.
dsh-kanban.queue.title: Add to a running session
dsh-kanban.reasoning.label: Reasoning Effort
dsh-kanban.report.title: Execution Report
dsh-kanban.revive.fresh: The old session was gone, so a new one started; the previous chat is not there any more.
dsh-kanban.revive.same: The old session came back — the chat is where you left it.
dsh-kanban.section.label: Kanban
dsh-kanban.settings.readOnly: Settings are read-only in this session.
dsh-kanban.settings.unavailable: The host does not know the dsh-kanban settings namespace. Restart the Web UI after installing the plugin.
dsh-kanban.stop.idle: The agent was not running — there was nothing to stop.
dsh-kanban.subtitle: Task board: Gitea issues and a session per task
dsh-kanban.sync.neverSeen: no successful check since the harness started
dsh-kanban.template.label: Task Template
dsh-kanban.title: Kanban
dsh-kanban.updater.success: Plugin updated successfully! Please restart DSH service.
dsh-kanban.updater.title: Plugin Updates
